# Steady: Sobriety & Habit Tracker

> Steady is a private, on-device sobriety and habit tracker for iOS and Android. It runs a live sobriety clock, takes a daily check-in, tracks money saved, keeps a mood and craving journal, and has a toolkit for hard moments (the user's reasons, a breathing guide, people to call or text, and helplines). There is no account, no ads, no social feed and no server: everything stays on the user's phone unless they turn on encrypted backup to their own iCloud or Google Drive. It is free to start; a one-time Premium purchase of $19.99 USD (no subscription) unlocks everything.

Steady is not a medical service and does not give medical advice. Insights describe patterns in what the user has logged.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iOS (App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6817491189); Android (Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lixlink.steady)
- Category: Health and wellness (sobriety, habit tracking)
- Account required: No. No sign-up, email address or login.
- Data storage: On the user's device. Steady has no server or database holding user data.
- Backup: Optional, Premium. Encrypted on the device before upload to the user's own iCloud or Google Drive.
- Pricing: Free to start. Premium is a one-time lifetime unlock for $19.99 USD (US price), no subscription.
- Free: sobriety clock, daily check-ins, money saved, milestone reminders, journal, toolkit for hard moments, app lock (Face ID, Touch ID, fingerprint or passcode), dark mode, one habit
- Premium: multiple habits, full history and streaks, Insights (mood, craving and trigger patterns), accent themes, encrypted cloud backup
- Data control: Users can export a plain-text copy of everything they've logged and delete all data permanently from within the app.
- Support: steady-support@lixlink.com

- [Help Center / FAQ](https://steady.lixlink.com/faq.html): Answers on the clock, check-ins, relapses and resets, the journal, Insights, the toolkit, app lock, notifications, privacy, backup and restore, export and delete, Premium purchases, and troubleshooting
- [Privacy Policy](https://steady.lixlink.com/privacy.html): What data Steady handles and why almost none leaves the device
- [Delete your data](https://steady.lixlink.com/delete-data.html): How to delete on-device data, cloud backups and purchase records

## Guides

- [Sobriety guides](https://steady.lixlink.com/guides/): Index of plain-language guides on tracking sobriety
- [How to keep track of your sobriety date](https://steady.lixlink.com/guides/how-to-track-your-sobriety-date.html): Choosing a sober date; tracking it on paper, in a calendar, with a spreadsheet formula (=TODAY()-date) or an app
- [Is there an app that can track my sober time?](https://steady.lixlink.com/guides/app-to-track-sober-time.html): What sobriety tracker apps do and a privacy and pricing checklist for choosing one
- [Which sobriety apps are free?](https://steady.lixlink.com/guides/free-sobriety-apps.html): Free-with-ads, subscription and one-time-unlock models; free tools such as NIAAA Rethinking Drinking
- [What is the hardest month of sobriety?](https://steady.lixlink.com/guides/hardest-month-of-sobriety.html): Month one, the months 2 to 4 dip (post-acute withdrawal) and what helps, with medical sources
- [Sobriety milestones](https://steady.lixlink.com/guides/sobriety-milestones.html): 24 hours to 1 year, with a milestone date calculator
- [Does a relapse reset your sobriety date?](https://steady.lixlink.com/guides/does-a-relapse-reset-your-sobriety-date.html): Slip vs relapse, what to do in the first 24 hours, and how Steady keeps past streaks
- [How much money do you save by quitting drinking?](https://steady.lixlink.com/guides/money-saved-quitting-drinking.html): Savings calculator and worked examples ($10 a day is about $3,650 a year)
